verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions payouts, settlement reports, fee breakdowns or reconciliation. The only nearby items are a generic marketing line about "powerful reporting" and an MCP tool to "review transactions". Neither is documented as itemized transaction and fee reporting matched against payouts, so they count only as adjacent features.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
